Valley Gazette

Fern Canyon reopens after storm repairs

Fern Canyon reopened to hikers on Monday after three weeks of repairs following the October storms. Crews replaced the wooden ladder at mile 2, which had been washed out, and cleared fallen alders from the lower trail.

Rangers recommend waterproof boots: the creek crossing near the trailhead is still running high.
